item.description: Miami, FL - January 31, 2026 - E11EVEN Miami celebrated its 12th Anniversary with a star-studded night featuring performances by 50 Cent, DaBaby, and Rich the Kid. item.title: WRE News: Florida Recreational Marijuana Measure Fails to Make 2026 Ballot
item.description: Miami, FL - February 2, 2026 - Florida’s push to legalize recreational marijuana has hit a major roadblock, with voters now unlikely to weigh in this November. State officials announced that a proposed constitutional amendment allowing adults to buy and use recreational marijuana failed to qualify for Florida’s 2026 ballot, after falling short of the nearly 880,000 verified signatures required.
